name: algo-akanade-react-native
description: A ready-made <AkanadeChatWidget> for any React Native app, built on the same algo-akanade-react-core hook the web widget uses, plus an optional voice adapter from algo-akanade-voice. Ships as raw .tsx source (no build step) — Metro (React Native's bundler) transpiles local/workspace TypeScript packages directly, the same way it transpiles your own app code.
